I can do that, but replacing a document is destructive. Please confirm you want me to replace the entire body of the document named "Onboarding checklist v4" with the exact text below (this will overwrite and remove the current content):

New body:
Day one - laptop pickup at the front desk, then sign the equipment form. Week one - shadow two support shifts and meet your onboarding buddy. Week two - take your first solo ticket queue with your buddy reviewing.

Reply with "Yes, replace" to proceed, or "No" to cancel. If you'd like, I can make a backup copy of the current document before replacing it—say "Yes, backup and replace" to request that.
